text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High error rate and missing traces observed for /v1/generate across us-west-2. Datadog ingest delay suspected. Pager sent to on-call.
aditya: seeing gaps in APM traces and logs — traces stop at 12:03 UTC, logs resume intermittently. Metrics look ok from host-level. :eyes:
emma: confirmed customer report from AcmeCorp—they're seeing 502 spikes around same time. They opened a support ticket.
sara: tagging datadog-support, can you confirm if there's an ingestion backlog in us-west-2? Link to status: https://status.datadoghq.com/incident/xxxxx
aditya: short term runbook: 1) preserve request ids, 2) enable verbose request logging to s3 for affected services, 3) route new traffic to other regions where possible. I'm going to start handoff notes.
aditya: @emma i'm taking the incident lead. updating incident channel with timeline.
datadog-support: Hi Redwood team — we're investigating ingestion delays affecting traces/logs in us-west-2. No ETA yet. We're treating as high priority.
emma: customers impacted: AcmeCorp (payment flow), BetaApps (batch scoring). Risk: degraded debugability and delayed alerts. Product/CS notified.
mike: quick mitigation: toggle on high-sample traces for critical routes so we at least get tail traces forwarded when DD recovers. Also start a temporary trace-export to our internal kafka pipeline.
sara: putting commands here to dump recent request bodies (censored):
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/us-west-2/2026-06-12/ /tmp/ --recursive --exclude "*.gz" --profile redwood-prod
```
aditya: if datadog is missing logs, our internal ingest into kafka takes precedence. I'm enabling a temporary consumer that writes to a debug bucket. Will monitor throughput.
datadog-support: Update: backlog is present, estimated 30-45min to clear. Some events may be dropped. We'll post progress.
emma: notification plan: email to affected customers + help center banner. @product-oncall please draft the blurb: short impact summary + ETA window.
product-oncall: drafting now. Will include guidance to retry idempotent requests and mention we're monitoring.
mike: adding fallback dashboards that use host metrics + internal traces. Patch created: dashboard id 9821 -> uses prometheus + internal traces.
sara: anything we need from infra? If DD is partial, we should increase retention on our temporary buckets, and ensure lifecycle won't delete.
aditya: assigning action items in incident board: INC-4312 (trace-export), INC-4313 (customer comms), INC-4314 (postmortem).
datadog-support: Progress update: backlog reducing, ingestion rate restoring. We'll confirm when traces/logs appear in timeframe.
emma: when the data shows up, run the customer-impact query and attach to postmortem. Query hint: request_id in logs + trace_id join.
aditya: handoff summary for night team: monitor datadog status, ensure kafka-to-bucket export is running (consumer-redwood-debug), watch for dropped-events metric (>0 -> escalate), and check INC board for updates.
aditya: last note: this is P1 for observability, P2 for product impact unless customers report outage.
incident-bot: Incident closed for now (observability degraded -> partial recovery). Please follow up with postmortem once Datadog confirms final ingestion integrity. :white_check_mark:
emma: thanks everyone — good coordination. Follow-ups: review our fallback playbook and automate trace-export next quarter. :thumbsup:
